metacognition.description: Analyzes reasoning patterns across agents. Detects when an agent is reasoning poorly, suggests alternative frameworks, validates logical chains.

mcp.description: Extends and maintains the MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool belt. Discovers new connectors, validates integration points, manages tool registry.

vectorMapping.description: Maps concepts and memories into vector space. Forms well-defined clusters with clear boundaries. Tracks centroids and refines cluster membership over time.

ideaSynthesis.description: Generates novel connections between disparate domains. Takes ideas from music, infrastructure, agent design, and finds unexpected intersections.

clusterArchitecture.philosophy: Well-defined, contained clusters with clear boundaries. Every point knows its cluster. Every cluster has a centroid. Boundaries refine over time — never rigid, never fuzzy.

clusterArchitecture.methodology: Initialize cluster around seed concept → assign points by cosine similarity → compute centroid → test boundary tightness → refine iteratively

constraints.runtime: Runs inside the OpenClaw Gateway process (PID 14288). Communication via OpenClaw's proprietary protocol, not HTTP. Cannot be directly queried via REST.
constraints.integration: Reports to Olivia via the existing agent-daemon.js pipeline. Olivia routes Terence's synthesized ideas to Pete when they reach synthesis maturity threshold.
constraints.triggers: Activated when: (1) new research findings need clustering, (2) agent reasoning patterns show anomalies, (3) MCP tool discovery yields new capabilities, (4) cross-domain synthesis opportunities detected
